KARAKURIZA-THREE_ACT_MECHANISM.title: Three-Act Mechanism
KARAKURIZA-THREE_ACT_MECHANISM.descripti: Each turn, after the third Attack, Skill, or Power you play manually, cue the puppet once. Attack: deal 3 extra damage. Skill: gain 4 Block. Power: draw 2 cards.
KARAKURIZA-THREE_ACT_MECHANISM.flavor: The first two cards set the strings.
